title: Harmonize Your UI: Master CSS 'font-size-adjust' for Consistent Web Font Readability
tweet: Struggling with visual inconsistencies when mixing web fonts? Learn how CSS 'font-size-adjust' can harmonize your UI's text readability. Essential for a superior user experience! #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign
tip: When pairing web fonts, especially for headings and body text, their intrinsic x-heights can vary greatly. Use 'font-size-adjust' to visually normalize their sizes, ensuring consistent readability and an improved user experience across your UI, regardless of the font fallback. This prevents jarring shifts when a preferred font fails to load.
